name: ContextMenu
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `ContextMenu(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

ContextMenuContent.description: The context menu's popup, opened at the pointer (start-aligned, 2px away).

ContextMenuTrigger.description: The area that opens the menu on right-click, long-press or Shift+F10 / the context-menu key. Renders a <div>; a block taking an argument receives the attributes for your own element.

examples.name: Basic
examples.notes: Right-click the area (long-press on touch, Shift+F10 when focused).
examples.code:
phlex do
  ContextMenu(size:, open_on_hover:, delay:, close_delay:) do
    ContextMenuTrigger(class: AREA, tabindex: "0") { "Right-click here" }
    ContextMenuContent do
      ContextMenuGroup do
        ContextMenuGroupLabel { "Edit" }
        { copy: [ "Copy", "⌘C" ], scissors: [ "Cut", "⌘X" ], clipboard: [ "Paste", "⌘V" ] }.each do |icon, (label, keys)|
          ContextMenuItem { Icon(icon, data: { icon: "start" }); plain label; Kbd(size: :sm, class: "ms-auto") { keys } }
        end
      end
      ContextMenuSeparator()
      ContextMenuItem(class: "text-error-emphasis") { Icon(:trash, data: { icon: "start" }); plain "Delete" }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: On a card
examples.notes: The trigger wraps any content - here a file card with a "Move to" submenu.
